observes: Negative controls of the disconnect/stop/lock-timeout checker: for each of the 17 points, one recorded observation seeded with one defect at a time (server process alive, open journal span, non-counter write outside a transaction, held lock, partial state, verify diverged, outcome contradicting the point, double application, different or phantom retry answer, committed span with an empty state, redaction left open, two redaction revisions, incomplete re-run, surviving row, changed records, wrong retry count, missing lock-timeout refusal): 164 of 164 seeded observations flagged; every source observation passes unmutated.
